KeyN.note: Cross-checked against Windows KBDINDEV.DLL, X11 in(deva) and a community chart — all three agree on the value shipped here. Kept Beta pending hands-on confirmation; flagged because the owner's prior (lost) session reported this key as disputed and that investigation could not be recovered.

Period.note: Shift value (।) matches both Windows and X11 official drivers, but several community exam-prep charts (e.g. jptyping.com) show the double danda (॥) instead. Kept as shipped (।) but flagged pending the owner confirming on a real exam-approved IME.

Slash.note: Fixed a copy/paste bug carried over from the legacy file: shift produced the same character as the base key. Corrected to य़ (U+095F) per Windows KBDINDEV.DLL, X11 in(deva) and jptyping.com, which all agree.

KeyZ.note: The legacy file itself was unverified ("KeyZ was added late"). Cross-checked against Windows KBDINDEV.DLL and the X11 in(deva) layout — both agree with the value shipped here. Kept Beta pending hands-on confirmation via the Keyboard tester (docs/06 rule 5).

Minus.note: Added from Windows KBDINDEV.DLL / X11 in(deva) (both agree): base "-", shift ः (visarga).

Equal.note: Added from Windows KBDINDEV.DLL / X11 in(deva) (both agree): base ृ (vocalic R matra), shift ऋ (vocalic R letter).

Backslash.note: Not present in the original legacy table; added from Windows KBDINDEV.DLL / X11 in(deva) (both agree: base ॉ candra-O matra, shift ऑ candra-O letter). Flagged pending hands-on confirmation because the owner's prior (lost) session reported this key as disputed and that investigation could not be recovered.
